RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, February 24, 2010/Phalguna 5, 1931 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Road Transport and Highways; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
7
Police-Public ratio in country
*21. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA:  Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) the total sanctioned strength and
vacancies in all branches of police, rank-
wise and State-wise;
(b) the police-public Ratio (Policemen
per 1000 people) in the country, State-
wise; and
(c) how does it compare with Western
and Asian countries and what is the United
Nations’ norm?
Proposal to convert police complaints
into FIRs
*22. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN:  Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry is considering
a proposal to convert all police complaints
into FIRs;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reasons therefor?
Foreign currency earned from export
of handicrafts
†*23. SHRI BRIJLAL KHABRI: Will
the Minister of  TAXTILES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that export of
handicrafts has increased during the current
year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the amount of foreign currency
earned by export of handicrafts during this
period; and
(d) the names of countries to which
handicrafts were exported?
Links of terror connnected with
neighbouring countries
†*24. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government is aware that
links of terror are connected with
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

8
neighbouring countries and their
Governments give patronage to them;
(b) whether illegal arms and fake
currencies are being trafficked from the
Middle East, Bangladesh and now even
from Nepal, and the centres of anti-India
activities have been established in these
countries;
(c) the efforts made by those
Governments so far to hand over the
declared terrorist conspirators living in
these countries to India; and
(d) the reasons for disappointing results
of these efforts?
Creation of separate Telangana
State
*25. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be pleased
to state:
(a) what were the circumstances which
necessitated unilateral decision favouring
creation of a separate Telangana State;
(b) whether it is a fact that such a
decision has encouraged others to demand
creation of separate States;
(c) if so, how the Government proposes
to deal with the situation; and
(d) whether Government proposes to
constitute a States Reorganization
Commission to consider these demands and
make recommendation thereon?
 Impact of Indo-Thai FTA
*26. SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) what has been the impact of the Indo-
Thai Free Trade Agreement (FTA) on the
Indian Auto industry; and
(b) which Japanese companies are
sourcing which vehicles for our domestic
market from Thailand?
Indian citizenship for those who fled
from Afghanistan
*27. SARDAR TARLOCHAN
SINGH: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a)  the number of persons who fled
from Afghanistan because of unrest and
have been given Indian Citizenship during
the last three years;
(b) the number of applications pending
and how long it will take to decide them;
and
(c) whether Government would adopt
a humanitarian policy to grant citizenship
to all of them?
Communal Violence Bill
*28. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that the
Communal Violence (Prevention, Control
and Rehabilitation of Victims) Bill is still
pending in the Parliament;
(b) if so, the reasons for pendency of
the Bill; and
(c) by when the Bill is likely to be got
passed?
Shortage of IPS officers
*29. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is acute shortage of
IPS officers in police forces;

9
(b) what is the ratio of population to
IPS officers and the comparative figures of
police officers and the population in
neighbouring countries; and
(c) when did Government realise the
shortage of IPS officers to deal with the
increasing problem of law and order in the
country?
Purpose of Malabar exercises
*30. SHRI TIRUCHI SIV A: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) what is the purpose of Malabar
exercises;
(b) whether one of the purposes of such
exercises is to test inter-operability of
forces; and
(c) whether Indian Defence doctrine
provides for such bilateral inter-operability?
Blacklisting  of  companies  from

SABHARWAL: W ill the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has in the past
banned or blacklisted companies from
supplying defence equipment if implicated
